lines.text: Jesus says not one temple stone will be left on another, and the disciples ask when this will happen.
Jesus warns of deceivers and says there will be wars, great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences.
Before all this, the disciples will be brought before kings and governors, and Jesus will give them speech and wisdom.
Parents, brothers, relatives, and priests will betray the disciples, yet by patient endurance they will gain their souls.
When armies surround Jerusalem, those in Judea should flee to the sea, and Gentiles will trample Jerusalem.
